title: Deep LLM layers expose passage-level context in EEG during silent reading
abstract: arXiv:2610.23638v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In a previous report we showed that a decoder can recover open-vocabulary word-level information from 19-channel EEG recorded during silent reading, by aligning short EEG windows with hidden-state embeddings of the presented word taken from a large language model (LLM). That analysis contrasted two of the model's 33 layers: the context-free input embedding and one mid-depth layer. Here we ask how EEG-decodable structure is distributed over the full depth of the language model. We trained one decoder per layer of Llama-3.1-8B, with and without a causal transformer over the sequence of EEG windows. We distinguish word-level decodability from a context-tracking component. Word-level decodability peaks in early layers and declines steadily towards the last layer. In contrast, the context-tracking component of the retrieval gain rises with depth, both with and without a causal transformer. Unexpectedly, a decoder that sees a single 0.5-s wind

translated_title: 深度大语言模型层揭示默读期间脑电图中的段落级上下文信息
translated_abstract: 在之前的报告中，我们展示了解码器能够从默读期间记录的19通道脑电图（EEG）中恢复开放词汇的词级信息，方法是将短EEG时间窗与从大语言模型（LLM）中提取的所呈现单词的隐状态嵌入进行对齐。该分析对比了该模型33层中的两层：无上下文的输入嵌入层和一个中间深度层。在本研究中，我们探讨EEG可解码结构如何分布于语言模型的全部深度。我们为Llama-3.1-8B的每一层分别训练了解码器，并在有和没有作用于EEG时间窗序列的因果Transformer两种条件下进行。我们区分了词级可解码性与上下文追踪成分。词级可解码性在早期层达到峰值，并随着接近最后一层而稳步下降。相比之下，检索增益中的上下文追踪成分随深度增加而上升，无论是否使用因果Transformer均是如此。出乎意料的是，一个仅观察单个0.5秒时间窗的解码器……
tldr: 该研究通过对大语言模型Llama-3.1-8B每一层表征训练EEG解码器，发现默读时词级信息在模型早期层最易解码，而段落级上下文信息随模型深度增加而增强，表明深层LLM表征与阅读中的上下文加工相关。
en_tdlr: By training EEG decoders on every layer of Llama-3.1-8B, this study finds that word-level information during silent reading is most decodable in early LLM layers, while passage-level context information increases with depth, indicating that deep LLM representations capture contextual processing during reading.
